source.derivation: Independent read-only calibration from the public TRAIN split only.
derivationProcedure: Select only C06 intervals from public TRAIN labels.
Sum ems_total_elz_target_kw over every inclusive one-minute event sample and divide by 60 to obtain target energy.
Divide each subtype's summed reference impact by its summed target energy, round the coefficient to three decimals, and verify every event rounds back to its published three-decimal impact.
Reproduce with python -m h2_analytics.tools.calibrate_c06 TIMESERIES LABELS; the tool emits hashes and aggregate statistics without retaining official rows.
source.heldOutPolicy: Held-out validation is acceptance-only and is never used to set rates.

C01.formula: sum(abs(bess_power_actual_kw - socTrackingGainKwPerPct * (bess_soc_pct - soc_target_pct)) * samplingIntervalMinutes / 60) over inclusive event rows
derivationProcedure: Use only public TRAIN C01 labels and their inclusive time-series rows.

Compare candidate baselines per event against reference_impact_value: the in-window median matched 36/40 within 10%, pre-event window medians matched at most 38/40, and the SOC-tracking counterfactual matched 40/40 within rounding.

The SOC-tracking gain is inherited from the C03 TRAIN calibration (same coefficient, never re-fit) because both official reference baselines reduce to the same SOC-tracking response under the positive-discharge convention.
Reproduce with python -m h2_analytics.impact.reconcile TIMESERIES LABELS --split train; validation is acceptance-only and is never an input to the baseline choice.
C01.roundingPolicy: Retain full precision during calculation; round only at export.
C01.rationale: The official reference baseline BESS power is the SOC-tracking counterfactual response; setpoint-oscillation impact is the integrated absolute deviation from it.
C01.limitation: Rows missing BESS actual power or either SOC value contribute no estimate, mirroring the C03 policy.
C01.heldOutPolicy: Held-out validation is acceptance-only and is never used to set the C01 baseline.

C02.formula: sum over affected electrolyzers of max(0, elz_power_cmd_kw - elz_power_actual_kw) * samplingIntervalMinutes / 60 over inclusive event rows
C02.affectedEquipmentSource: window implicated_equipment_ids restricted to ELZ01/ELZ02/ELZ03; an empty set falls back to all three units so blind inputs degrade instead of crashing
derivationProcedure: Use only public TRAIN C02 labels and their inclusive time-series rows.

Compare candidate aggregation scopes per event against reference_impact_value: summing the positive command-actual gap over all three electrolyzers matched 23/40 within 10%, while summing only the labeled affected unit matched 40/40 within rounding.
Available/run-state filters did not change the all-unit scope mismatch, confirming the official scope is the affected unit rather than a running-state filter.
Reproduce with python -m h2_analytics.impact.reconcile TIMESERIES LABELS --split train; validation is acceptance-only and is never an input to the scope choice.
C02.roundingPolicy: Retain full precision during calculation; round only at export.
C02.rationale: Unserved electrolyzer energy is attributed to the unit whose capacity was not synchronized; other units' tracking gaps belong to normal regulation and are excluded by the official reference.
C02.limitation: Runtime scope depends on the detector attributing the same unit as the official label; attribution quality is tracked separately by detection metrics.
C02.heldOutPolicy: Held-out validation is acceptance-only and is never used to set the C02 scope.

C03.formula: sum(abs(bess_power_actual_kw - socTrackingGainKwPerPct * (bess_soc_pct - soc_target_pct)) * samplingIntervalMinutes / 60) over inclusive event rows
derivationProcedure: Use only public TRAIN C03 labels and their inclusive time-series rows.
Treat gain * (bess_soc_pct - soc_target_pct) as the counterfactual SOC-tracking BESS response under the official positive-discharge and negative-charge convention.
Solve one aggregate TRAIN-only gain from total reference impact, actual BESS magnitude, and signed SOC deviation, then round the gain to three decimals before freezing it.
Reproduce with python -m h2_analytics.tools.calibrate_c03 TIMESERIES LABELS; validation is not an input to the tool.
C03.roundingPolicy: Retain full precision during calculation; round only at export.
C03.rationale: The SOC-tracking gain is an empirical public-TRAIN calibration coefficient, not a physical BESS constraint.
C03.limitation: The public files expose rounded event measurements rather than the hidden unrounded counterfactual trace; the frozen gain reproduces aggregate TRAIN reference impact within 0.001 kWh while event-level rounded residuals remain explicitly reported.
C03.heldOutPolicy: Held-out validation is acceptance-only and is never used to set the C03 gain.

C06.formula: sum(ems_total_elz_target_kw * subtypeRate * samplingIntervalMinutes / 60) over inclusive event rows
C06.roundingPolicy: Retain full precision during calculation; round only at export.
C06.rationale: Rates are empirical public-TRAIN calibration coefficients, not physical limits or constraints.
